protocol: Serial cold CLI processes, fresh copies/caches per arm/seed. Rotating/reversing arm order. Fixed maximum equals image budget. No gate switches. Full output-conditioned metrics only; missing outputs stay failures. Families, not seeds, determine evidence coverage.
execution_notes: Serial conversion arms; repository tests ran concurrently for part of this final measurement. Startup timeouts without observations remain failures. Recollected native artifacts have null CLI batch duration/return code when those were not recorded. Preliminary constructor/setup probes and failed controls are retained separately. No runtime algorithm or quality gate changed during this final matrix.
